nina: Quick check 6 CloudMarket reviewer asked for a one-paragraph statement on key export policy for our CipherWorks listing. Can someone confirm wording?

emma: CipherWorks: BYOK import supported; keys non-exportable from HSM unless wrapped per partner policy. Suggest: "CipherWorks-managed HSM (BYOK import); key export/wrap policies are defined by CipherWorks and detailed in partner attestation."

raj: Minor tweak: add parenthetical that Redwood does not control partner key export. So: "CipherWorks-managed HSM (BYOK import). Key export/wrap policies are defined by CipherWorks; Redwood does not control partner key export. See partner attestation."

sophie: Confirmed from CipherWorks: wording acceptable. We can provide FIPS cert PDF and a signed attestation by EOD Friday.

marketplace-bot: Submission updated. Reviewer note: attach attestation and a sanitized audit-log sample to finish verification (ref CM-6219).

emma: I'll request the audit sample and the attestation now and post attachments here.

nina: Thanks  will keep reviewer in loop and use the neutral wording for now.
